meta.description: Fired by the HRIS once per MESA opt-out, disbursement or return request a member files from Employee → MESA → Request (POST /api/mesa-requests; Accounting decisions and archiving never fire it). Acks immediately, then emails each recipient in the payload that a request is waiting in Accounting → MESA → Requests (who / which request / department / when / reference id + a button to the HRIS). Recipients come from the HRIS — default carla@simple.biz and april@simple.biz, changed in Admin → Webhooks → MESA Request → Notify Accounting → Open automation. Subject/body are fixed in Build MESA Emails; no peso figure and no reason are ever sent. Attach the hris@simple.biz Gmail OAuth2 credential to the send node before activating (that account is the sender); register the production URL under Admin → Webhooks slug `mesa_request_notify` (or env N8N_MESA_REQUEST_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL); optionally set REQUIRED_SECRET here + N8N_MESA_REQUEST_NOTIFY_SECRET in the HRIS to lock the webhook.
